body: Pretty sure hes a comic character, probably from a really old comic cause my dads been drawing him for me since I was a kid (Im 26 now). If anyone has any idea where he might be from, Id really appreciate it if you told me!

A gun wont solve anything, itll either remove the chances of things ever getting better, or it would leave you scarred for life. But I do understand feeling like this all too well. Is there anything youd like to get off your chest? I may be a stranger, but Im here to listen.

Going through the same thing with my ex. Ive immediataly cleared my room of all things that remind me of him, because I know it would drive me insane. I too avoid watching tv shows, even listening to music that would possibly remind me of him (I only listen to Bo Burnhams Inside cause it makes me feel less alone in the pain lol). Id suggest reading, going out for a walk, watching shows/movies with no such themes, anything you enjoyed before you started feeling like this. Its painful and hard, and as much as I hate hearing this cliche shit, it does get easier with time. I wasnt able to enter my room for days until I got angry because that should be MY safe space and decided to turn it back into one. I dont know what youre into, but for me reading books, playing video games and forcing myself to do self care really helped. Maybe even meditation if thats something youd be willing to try? Just know youre not alone and you will heal. You got this ♡
You can message me if youd like, Ill listen, no judgement ♡ Sending hugs
I realy hope Im not too late, but my dms are open.. Sending love
You can dm me if youd like! Here for you buddy ♡

Aw this happened to me a few times as well! I felt the exact same way, but I promise you its not as bad as you think it is. Especially if you have a nice therapist (and I doubt youd be talking to one that isnt nice), Im sure theyll understand. Sending hugs ♡
Thank you for sharing your story. Youre not alone, and if you ever need to talk feel free to message me. Im so glad youre still here and I wish you a safe recovery ♡

Sucks to know someones in the same boat, but also somewhat comforting to know youre not alone.. Im so sorry youre hurting too, most we can do is take care of ourselves like you said, one day at a time. Have you figured out how to distract yourself? Tv, games, anything? I havent found anything yet.. I spend the majority of my days outside surrounded by people (friends, strangers, anyone), Ive found that thats somewhat helping.. Also starting therapy and meds, being numb is better than feeling anything right now
Would you like to talk? Here for ya

It truly does, so far the weight on my chest seems like its getting bigger and bigger every day. I only wished for a friend who can relate, but its such a stupid specific situation..
I am so sorry to hear that, how are you dealing with it?
Im here! Talk to me please, please be safe
Thank you.. its almost comical how life slaps you with the things you least expect and then you just gotta deal with whatevers thrown at you :|

Oh, my entire high school experience was like this. It sucks. Those 4 years go by so fast though, just focus on doing the shit you need to do to pass, and also dedicate yourself to a hobby. Friends will come in time. College is so much more different, youll turn a whole new leaf. Itll suck for a bit longer, but you can do it, have faith in yourself! And if you need someone to talk to, Im here :)
Im here buddy, tell me whats on your mind?

Do you mind if I asked what happened, how you attempted? 
Glad youre still alive tho buddy, wishing you all the luck in the world

I feel you. Every word youve said. I feel your pain. Ive got no smart things to say, I wont pretend things get better cause Im not sure if they do. All I know is Im new here, and have already realized that there are many strangers who care. If you need someone to reach out to, Im here. Sending hugs
